scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ws=['shared','backend','frontend','simulator'].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(ws.length)require('child_process').execSync('npm run build -w shared --if-present && npm run build --workspaces --if-present',{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('No workspaces to build yet.');"
scripts.lint: eslint . && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ws=['shared','backend','frontend','simulator'].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(ws.length)require('child_process').execSync('npm run lint --workspaces --if-present',{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('Root lint clean; no workspaces to lint yet.');"
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ws=['shared','backend','frontend','simulator'].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(ws.length)require('child_process').execSync('npm run typecheck -w shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present',{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('tsconfig.base.json valid; no workspaces to typecheck yet.');"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ws=['shared','backend','frontend','simulator'].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(ws.length)require('child_process').execSync('npm run test --workspaces --if-present',{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('No workspace tests to run yet.');"
scripts.demo:up: docker compose up postgres redis -d --wait && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsx backend/prisma/seed.ts
